Impact                                                                    
   
                                 




### Impact

A flaw in the signup flow allowed newly registered users to gain whisper-group privileges without legitimate group membership, granting them read and post access to whisper content (typically used for moderator-only discussion embedded inside otherwise-visible topics).

This vulnerability only affects sites that have configured the `whispers_allowed_groups` site setting to include one or more groups. The default configuration is not affected.     

### Patches

Upgrade to the patched version.

### Workarounds
 
Clear the `whispers_allowed_groups` site setting until the patch is applied. This disables whispers but blocks the issue.
repo.summary: Signup-time primary_group_id assignment grants whisperer access
